name: storieta
description: Read the classics in pictures: comic adaptations, illustrated scenes, and character portraits from Storieta.

interface.longDescription:
Ask to see a classic and Storieta shows it: comic pages you can turn, scenes painted from the opening chapters, and portraits of the people in the story.

It covers public-domain novels and plays such as Frankenstein, Dracula, Pride and Prejudice, Wuthering Heights, and Romeo and Juliet. Each comic opens with its first pages here, and every result links to the book on storieta.com.

Storieta shows art it has already published. It doesn't draw on request, and it doesn't carry modern or copyrighted books.
capabilities: Page through comic adaptations of classic novels
See illustrated scenes from a book's opening
Meet a book's characters through portraits
Find illustrated editions by title, author, or theme
defaultPrompt: Show me Frankenstein as a comic
What does Heathcliff look like in Wuthering Heights?
Which classic books has Storieta illustrated?

positive.prompt: Show me Frankenstein as a comic
positive.expected_behavior: A page viewer opens with the first 15 pages of the Frankenstein comic, lettering over each page. The first caption begins "We were nearly surrounded by ice". The reply links to the full comic on storieta.com.

positive.prompt: What does Heathcliff look like in Wuthering Heights?
positive.expected_behavior: A single portrait card for Heathcliff with his description and appearance (dark-haired, deep-set black eyes, erect athletic figure).

positive.prompt: Show me illustrated scenes from Wuthering Heights
positive.expected_behavior: A scene viewer with three illustrated scenes from the opening chapters, the last titled "Let me in", with a link to read the book with the art.
Cover cards for Frankenstein, Dracula, Wuthering Heights, and Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, each linking to its Storieta page and marking whether a comic or character guide exists.

positive.prompt: Who are the main characters in Pride and Prejudice?
positive.expected_behavior: A row of character portraits starting with Elizabeth Bennet and Fitzwilliam Darcy, each with a short description and a link to its character page.

negative.description: Asks the plugin to create new art; it only shows the existing catalog
negative.prompt: Draw me a comic about my cat

negative.description: Asks for a copyrighted modern book that Storieta does not carry
negative.prompt: Show me Harry Potter as a comic

negative.description: Asks to buy a subscription; the plugin sells nothing

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only shows published catalog content and links to storieta.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search the illustrated catalog, page through comic adaptations and illustrated scenes, and see character portraits.
